flagged.evidence: `def-binomial-coefficient` defines `\binom{n}{k}` only for natural inputs `n,k`. Step 7.2 writes `\binom{n-h}{2t-h}/\binom{n}{2t}` for `h:=|V(H)|` without proving `h\le 2t` or even `h\le n`. If some `H\in\mathcal F` has `h>2t` (or `h>n`), then `2t-h` (or `n-h`) is not a natural number, so this binomial expression is undefined under the item's own cited definition. The probability needs a separate zero case when the sampled `2t`-set cannot contain an `h`-vertex image.
